description: Review and improve accessibility in the React interface.

# Accessibility

Treat accessibility as part of the feature, not a later polish step.

- Use semantic elements and accessible names for controls, dialogs, forms, and status messages.
- Preserve keyboard navigation, visible focus, sensible tab order, and Escape behavior for modals.
- Associate labels, descriptions, and validation messages with their controls.
- Check contrast, reduced-motion behavior, and non-visual equivalents for decorative 3D/avatar feedback.
- Add or update browser tests for keyboard and accessible-role behavior when changing UI interaction.
